notes.notes:

SPARTANS!! HEAR ME!



It is true what many of you have heard...

The Persians have gathered an army and as I speak, that army is drawing nearer to our home.

notes.title: Awesome Achievements
notes.notes:
GATHER AROUND, SPARTANS!

I have great news for you.

All the 45 achievements are implemented in the game ready for the release on March 22nd.
And I have to tell you, they are REALLY AWESOME!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39957388/f4b8e0e5b5e944cafba585d7f478d19164cf284a.gif[/img]

Because the game is an open-ended roguelike (meaning the game only ends when you die), the achievements are an incredible opportunity to present secondary goals and modifiers that keep the game engaging and challenging no matter your skill level.

And with the 200+ items, surprises will keep popping in every corner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39957388/c414e37cbcf3783f4c6ddd5d4bafbeb9019f70e1.gif[/img]

Be sure to WISHLIST the game so you don't miss the release on the 22nd!

I'll see you on the battle, Spartan!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1490180/For_Sparta/

notes.title: For Sparta Announcement!
notes.notes:
We are very excited to announce our new game: [b]For Sparta[/b]!

[previewyoutube=ewHT1jqoceM;full][/previewyoutube]

You probably heard about the Battle of Thermopylae, where 300 Spartans stood between one million Persians and the fate of Greece.
Well.. 299 already fell and now only you can stop them in [i]For Sparta[/i], a fast-paced single-screen arena roguelike.

For Sparta features +200 gameplay-changing items, more than 40 unique enemies and a fluid arcade-like top-down pixel art combat.

The game was developed by two brothers, from Gamecraft Studios and is coming on this [b]March 22nd[/b] to Steam for [b]$1.99[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1490180/For_Sparta/
